new_jobs.title: 【優式創投】經營管理經理
new_jobs.jd: 【職位描述】 負責被投企業與事業體之經營管理，以企業內部實戰經驗協助各事業體建立健全的組織體質與管理能力，並持續追蹤經營成效。依事業體階段與需求，深入第一線，與經營團隊並肩推動管理落地。 【主要職責】 - 規劃並落實董事會機制，協助各事業體建立正式治理架構 - 設計並導入 KPI/OKR 管理制度，並協助跨企業套用與調整 - 規劃並協助召開股東會、董事會等公司治理會議 - 建立財務管理標準流程，包含月報、現金流管理、預算編列與管理報表設計 - 提供各事業體經營團隊管理諮詢 - 設計人才制度，包含招募流程、薪酬與激勵機制、組織架構 - 建立內部風險控管機制，識別營運、財務及法遵風險並提出對策 - 依專案需求,彈性投入各事業體營運現場,協助管理機制落地 - 追蹤並回報制度導入率、KPI/OKR 達成率等管理指標 【條件需求】 - 具備企業內部經營管理實務經驗 (營運長、高階幕僚或事業單位負責人等) - 具備公司治理、KPI/OKR 制度設計與導入之實務經驗 - 具備財務管理基礎，能解讀財務報表與管理報表 - 具備同時推動多項專案或輔導多個單位的能力，能將管理框架複製並因地制宜調整 - 能適應彈性的工作型態與場域，樂於在第一線與團隊共同解決問題 【加分條件】 - 於經營管理相關職位取得具體、可衡量的卓越績效(如營收成長、獲利改善、組織規模擴張、募資或上市籌備成果) - 具備 PE/VC 投後管理、Operating Partner 或集團總管理處、控股公司子公司管理經驗 - 曾主導併購後整合或集團重組相關專案 - 具備股權激勵機制設計實務經驗 - 熟悉多產業別營運模式，具跨產業管理經驗

new_jobs.title: 執行長特助暨財務幕僚
new_jobs.jd: **\*行業背景經驗** • 10 年以上工作經驗，其中至少 5 年財務相關經歷 （事務所審計／財顧、企業財務主管或財務經理）。 • 具跨部門專案推動或營運管理經驗；新創、餐飲、零售、電商或平台產業經驗尤佳。 **\*專業資格條件** • 能獨立編製並解讀三大財務報表（損益表、資產負債表、現金流量表）。 • 熟悉預算編列與現金流管理。 **\*職責範圍** 1. 營運節奏與進度追蹤(核心)：主持或協辦高管週會，追蹤 KPI 大總表與跨部門待辦；建立 OKR／KPI 追蹤機制；追蹤推進擔任跨部門專案 PMO。 2. 新策略與外部合作落地：將執行長的新策略與合作案拆解為可執行計畫（負責人、里程碑、風險），並追蹤推進。 3. 財務管理：督導月結、產出三大報表與管理報表；建立並追蹤預算、現金流預測與部門費用；解讀財報提出改善行動；支援募資、銀行授信與政府補助案；督導財會人員並對接會計師事務所。 4. 員工關係與人事制度：協助人資部門進行員工溝通、衝突處理與留才事務；協助優化考核、薪酬、獎金與規章制度，未來督導協作 HRBP（不直線管理業務／營運團隊）執行落地公司人資策略規劃。 5. 高階文書：董事會資料、投資人更新、合約審閱重點、銀行與補助文件，確保數字品質準確一致。 **\*工作技能條件** 1. 跨部門專案推動與營運管理，習慣用數據與進度表追蹤事情。 2. 文字能力佳，能產出董事會與投資人等級的文件。 3. 熟悉 AI 與數位工具，願意以自動化取代重複性工作（加分）。 **\*人格特質** 高度值得信任、細心、具彈性，能妥善處理機密資訊；不需被盯就會把事情做完；能與不同性格的主管合作，靠影響力而非職權推動事情；對數字敏感，看到異常會追問到底。 **\*加分條件** 1. 曾任董事長特助、總經理室、Chief of Staff 或 CFO 副手。 2. 新創、餐飲、零售、電商或平台產業經驗；參與過募資、銀行授信或政府補助案。 3. 具人資或組織發展經驗；熟悉 AI 與數位工具。 4.具備流暢的英文口說溝通能力(多益750以上)。

new_jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner (南區Hema&Immuno)
new_jobs.jd: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position **Role Purpose** * Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve * The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster * The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions * This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs) * It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey * The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem * Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster * Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community * Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner * By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem * The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs * Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services **Requirements:** **Qualifications:** **Education:** * University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus * Practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies * CCXA Academy (desired) **Working Experience:** **Skills & Knowledge:** * System thinker and deep listener * Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with TAE's and organizations is required. Experience partnering with PAGs is highly desired * Experience leading Cross-functional team is required. Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams is highly desired * Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence * Able to understand and leverage digital means and tools is desired * Deep experience in agile ways of working is desired **Competencies:** The PJP demonstrates personal purpose around improving the patient journey, as well as strong passion to create value and impact on the ecosystem. They think from an Enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally. * Visionary: defining and embedding the strategy around creating improved patient journeys * Mindset: + Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand) + Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche + Self managed and self directed - altruistic in supporting the global network + Display of integrity in everything (i.e. open, honest, ethical and genuine) * Enabler mindset leveraging the internal and external networks to create value, sharing back and scaling * Boldly acts on key decisions and opportunities and boldly stops any activity that is not adding value. Ability to say “No” to stakeholders when the value is not predictable/foreseen **Others (i.e. Travel Requirement):** * Fluent in local language. Proficient in English to collaborate internally * across the broader Roche enterprise is highly desired Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. **Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

new_jobs.jd: ****Our Journey**** The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific's leading shopping and rewards platform, trusted by over 20 million active members across 13 markets, including Germany and the United States. Founded in Singapore in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales and half a million transactions a day for more than 20,000 online and in-store partners. At ShopBack, AI is how we build. It is not a side tool. You will ship products with AI agents as teammates, and you will build the systems that make those agents fast, secure, and reliable. You will join our engineering team in Taiwan, which owns ShopBack's authentication system and builds AI products, including agent and conversational experiences. Both fresh graduates and experienced engineers are welcome to apply. **What You'll Own** * Own products end to end. You take a product from idea to design, build, test, ship, and operate. You build skills, tools, MCP servers, and agent workflows that your whole team uses every day, instead of one-off prompts that nobody can reuse. * Make AI output measurable. You build evals, tests, and guardrails so that we can trust what agents produce. "It looks right" is not enough. * Build loops, not tasks. You connect agents to CI, code review, observability, and incident data so the system gets better each time it runs. * Design clean, scalable services. You build the APIs and services behind our apps, including authentication and AI products. * Find where AI changes the product itself. You work with product, data, and design on ideas that go beyond changing how we build. * Explain trade-offs clearly. You analyse requirements, propose solutions, and say when AI is the wrong tool. * Raise the bar. You know system design, data structures, testing, and debugging. AI makes good engineers better. It does not replace fundamentals. * Proof that you applied AI, not only used it. Show us something you built. * Ownership and a positive attitude toward change. You push things forward, work across product and design, and are excited by how fast AI is changing engineering. * Learning velocity. You pick up new tools fast, and you drop old habits when a better tool arrives. * Experienced engineers: you have built and run services in the cloud. Experience with consumer-facing products is a plus. * Fresh graduates: side projects, hackathons, internships, and open source all count. **Bonus Points** * You built agent infrastructure at scale: sandboxes, runtimes, orchestration, or permission models. * You designed LLM-as-judge or eval pipelines that the team trusts. * You shipped AI features to real users and handled cost, latency, and failure modes. * You put AI into the SDLC: automated MR review, test generation, or incident triage. * You have worked on security, identity, or authentication systems. **Technologies We Use & Love** * Core: TypeScript / Node.js, React, Postgres, Kafka, SQS, Kubernetes on AWS, Knative, Debezium * Delivery & Ops: GitLab CI, Datadog * Data: Redshift, Spark, S3 * AI: Claude Code / Codex, MCP We care more about how fast you learn a stack than about which stack you already know. ****ShopBacker Traits**** * Agency - We take ownership and act, rather than waiting for permission. We benchmark ourselves against the best and keep raising our own bar. * Tenacity - We stay in it when things get hard, keeping a level head under pressure. We debate openly before deciding, then commit fully — and support each other along the way. ****What's in it for ShopBackers**** * Career growth opportunities to take on greater challenges that help you realise your ambitions. * Be part of a winning team on a journey to global scale. * Competitive compensation based on performance. * Candid, open, and collaborative culture where feedback is valued. new_jobs.jd: Instrumental builds the manufacturing acceleration platform behind the world’s most complex electronics. We capture digital exhaust and engineering context from assembly lines—images, test logs, BOM data, performance, repair cycles—and our AI engines identify insights that are difficult or impossible for human engineers to find. We accelerate the companies building the AI era by improving manufacturing yield, throughput, and ramp. NVIDIA, Meta, L3Harris, and their manufacturing partners rely on Instrumental to accelerate new product introduction and production. Instrumental has become mission-critical for manufacturers building and scaling the next generation of AI infrastructure hardware. Manufacturing advanced electronics requires understanding millions of signals generated across complex assembly processes. Instrumental builds systems that capture and analyze those signals — images, test results, and process data — enabling engineers to discover failures, identify root causes, and deploy production controls that improve yield and product maturity. Leading companies such as NVIDIA, Cisco, and Meta rely on Instrumental to accelerate new product development and scale manufacturing across global factories. Instrumental has become mission-critical for manufacturers building and scaling the next generation of AI infrastructure hardware. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of **manufacturing operations, hardware deployment, and software integration** . You will work closely with global electronics brands and their contract manufacturers to deploy Instrumental systems, integrate factory data pipelines, and ensure production data flows reliably into our platform. Successful candidates are strong executors who thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy solving operational problems, and take pride in turning complex factory deployments into reliable systems. Ideal candidates enjoy working directly with factory teams and solving real manufacturing deployment challenges. **Responsibilities** * Own Customer Deployments: Lead the execution of Instrumental deployments at customer factories and contract manufacturers. Work with customer stakeholders to ensure the platform is integrated into manufacturing workflows and delivering actionable insights.
